verdict.headline: SK Hynix record Q2 fails to arrest five-day chip selloff; FOMC binary (2pm ET) and META/MSFT AH earnings are today's clearing events
verdict.label: Step Aside — SK Hynix +257% YoY revenue, 76% OM, HBM4 mass production launched yet stock -8-13% on missed inflated estimates; Brent $89.53 (day 4 above $85 regime trigger, re-surging); FOMC announces 2pm ET — Warsh's September language (hike prob 75-82%) is the market binary; META (9% implied move) and MSFT (7% implied move) report AH tonight; BTC 24h low $62,727 touched within $727 of Gate 2
verdict.rationale_short: Wednesday morning delivers the week's primary clearing event: FOMC decision at 2pm ET (Warsh press conference 2:30pm) with September hike probability at 75-82% per CME FedWatch — the hold is fully priced, the language is not. Warsh inherits Brent crude at $89.53 (fourth consecutive session above the $85 formal regime trigger, re-surging overnight on continued Iran military action), a 30-year yield at 5.12%, and two dissents at the July meeting (first multiple dissents since 1993), conditions that make an explicitly dovish statement analytically difficult. SK Hynix's Q2 2026 results were structurally landmark — revenue +257% YoY to 79.3T won, operating margin 76%, HBM4 mass production launched — yet the stock fell 8-13% because the results missed sky-high analyst estimates (expected: 84T won revenue, 64T won operating profit), crystallizing the theme that expectations are structurally above fundamentals across the AI infrastructure trade even when the fundamentals are excellent. AMD recovers slightly (+1.03% premarket to $459) while MU is -5%+ and Intel -4%+, extending the five-day semiconductor selloff. META and MSFT report AH tonight — options pricing 9% and 7% implied moves respectively — delivering the AI capex ROI clarity event that defines the Magnificent 7 bull/bear narrative for Q3. BTC stabilized at $64,495 (Crypto.com, 11:03 UTC) but the 24h session low of $62,727 touched within $727 of Gate 2 ($62,000). Step aside; do not add directional tech or semiconductor exposure before 2pm ET. Convert to action post-FOMC statement.

trade_setups.asset: FOMC rates binary (TBT long / TLT long pair)
trade_setups.thesis: The FOMC statement at 2pm ET (Warsh press conference 2:30pm) is the year's single highest-information rate event. Warsh inherits: Brent at $89.53 (four sessions above the $85 regime trigger, re-surging on Iran), 30Y at 5.12% (above 5.00% trigger), September hike probability at 78%, and two dissents at the July meeting — the first multiple dissents since 1993. These inputs make an explicitly dovish statement analytically difficult. The pair trades both outcomes: hawkish (September explicitly live, oil inflation acknowledged) → TBT long, 30Y tests 5.20%-5.25%, SPX tests 7,380; dovish (September de-emphasized, Iran diplomatic progress assumed) → TLT long, 10Y falls below 4.50%, tech/semis attempt relief rally. One leg converts to directional within 30 minutes of the 2pm statement.
trade_setups.entry: Build equal-weight TBT long / TLT long pair into the morning session — at least 60 minutes before 2pm ET. Do not wait for the statement. Let FOMC July 29 2pm decide which leg converts to directional. Close the losing leg within 30 minutes of the statement. Hold the winner for 2-3 weeks through August CPI (est. Aug 13).
trade_setups.invalidation: FOMC statement is genuinely ambiguous — acknowledges both inflation risk and soft growth without explicitly signaling September either way; 10Y holds 4.58-4.62% post-statement. Flatten both legs within 60 minutes.
trade_setups.horizon: Entry this morning; resolution at 2pm ET; convert survivor to August CPI hold (est. Aug 13)

When the best possible fundamental outcome still triggers an 8-13% stock decline, the sector's multiple-compression process is not complete. All three required simultaneously to flip bullish on semis. Single condition alone is insufficient.

bear_case: Counter-argument: The semiconductor selloff is approaching exhaustion territory after five consecutive sessions of losses across the US, Korean, and Japanese markets. AMD has fallen approximately 12% in four sessions; SK Hynix's actual Q2 numbers (revenue +257% YoY, 76% operating margin, HBM4 mass production started) demonstrate that AI infrastructure demand is converting to record profits at an accelerating rate — the 'missed estimates' narrative is an analyst expectations-management failure, not a fundamental deterioration. The futures are mildly positive (ES +0.2%, NQ +0.3%), AMD is recovering, and European stocks are holding firm despite the chip selloff. If FOMC delivers a clean hold without explicitly endorsing September as live — which is analytically defensible if Warsh focuses on the slowing Durable Goods data (Monday miss: 0.3% vs 2.5% expected) rather than oil — and if both META and MSFT tonight demonstrate improving AI capex ROI margins (the threshold is modest given GOOGL's negative template), the entire five-day selloff resolves as a classic overreaction to three compounding noise signals. The SK Hynix HBM4 mass production announcement is a fundamental positive for AI infrastructure demand visibility that the market will be forced to reprice. Counter-argument invalidation: If SPX reclaims 7,500 on the post-FOMC Wednesday close and AMD closes above $475, the step-aside call is wrong. If FOMC is explicitly dovish (September probability drops below 65%) AND MSFT Azure confirms >45% growth with credible ROI trajectory, the step-aside call is wrong.
